title: 第7章 忽然的升职
content_zh:
经过昨天一天，有了和女神的初次微笑，甚至还和女神同桌聊天之后，钟晓飞感觉他和女神的距离已经被拉近了，起码女神知道了他的名字，两个人算是相互认识了，所以今天他打算趁热打铁，等在公司的门口，假装和女神邂逅，说一声你好。最好能和女神聊上几句。

当然，最重要的是，他要解释误会，他要告诉吴怡洁，他还没有结婚呢。

五分钟后，吴怡洁出现了，白色的短袖衬衫，黑色的长及膝盖的筒裙，肉色的丝袜，白色的高根鞋，步伐轻盈，一身标准的职业装，婀娜多姿的走了过来。

钟晓飞兴奋的迎了上去，“嗨，你好……”

吴怡洁冷冷的看了他一眼，只看了一眼，然后就扭转了头，绝美的脸蛋是冷若冰霜的神情，就好像她根本不认识钟晓飞一样。

钟晓飞呆站在原地，脸上的笑容渐渐僵硬，他硬着头皮，不甘心的结结巴巴的说，“嗨，我是钟晓飞啊，你忘了吗？昨天……”

他的话没有说完，吴怡洁已经扬着头，径直从他身边走了过去。

钟晓飞心里的滋味像是打翻了五味瓶，苦涩，失望……

看来，戴大美女根本没有把他当成一回事。

进了公司，坐到自己的座位上，钟晓飞失魂落魄的，他不是一个拿不起，放不下的男人，只是情况转变的太快，让他难以接受。上班之前他还充满了幸福的幻想，现在却被打了两个闷棍。

电话响了，是投资部的女秘书何美怡打过来的。何美怡是一名美熟妇，胸大屁股大，属于丰满多汁型的，虽然不在公司的七大美女的排行之列，但她的姿色一点都不差，而且今年刚满三十岁，正是如狼似虎的年龄。据说，李三石的老婆熊慧林对她很警惕，一直怀疑丈夫用这样的女人当秘书是不安好心，不过何美怡的工作是董事长杨天增亲自安排的，不是李三石想换就能换的。

“钟晓飞！过来一下，李经理找你有事！”何美怡的声音里面带着笑。

“哦，何姐，知道什么事吗？”钟晓飞振作精神，压低了声音问。李三石贵为投资部的总经理，钟晓飞只是他手下的一个小职员，平常很少有交集，忽然被叫到办公室，钟晓飞心里不免有点紧张，心说难道是我的交易出错了？唉，祸不单行啊，刚刚被女神冷遇，现在又要被上司责怪了吗？

“好事！”何美怡娇笑着挂断了电话。

钟晓飞放心了，放下电话，向李三石的办公室走去。李三石的办公室宽大又豪华，简直像是星级酒店。在外面的秘书间里，何美怡正在打电话，房门是敞开着的，钟晓飞站在门前，用手指轻轻的敲了一下房门，何美怡抬头看见他，向他猛眨眼睛。

何美怡身材高挑，**肥臀，一双大眼睛水汪汪的，和公司里面其他的美女不同，她是标准的熟女，结婚有丈夫，钟晓飞还曾经见过她的丈夫，一个瘦瘦高高的中年人，在外资公司里担任高级经理人，不过最近刚被派到国外工作了，估计得两三年才能回来。

何美怡朝钟晓飞眨眼睛，示意等一下。

钟晓飞走进来站着等，眼睛自然而然的落在何美怡身上。

何美怡穿着公司统一配发的短袖白色衬衫，胸前开了两个小扣子，**出一大片雪白的胸脯和两条玉藕般的手臂，黑色的筒裙，肉色的丝袜，打电话的时候，大腿不停的晃来晃去。非常的性感、清凉。

”李经理，钟晓飞来了……”原来何美怡正在跟她的老板李三石通电话。

何美怡放下电话，朝钟晓飞笑，“经理让你进去。”

“哦。”钟晓飞朝何美怡眨眨眼睛，小声说了一句，“何姐，你今天真美……”

“少跟姐耍嘴皮子……”何美怡嗔怒，

但钟晓飞看的出，其实她心里很受用。

到了李三石办公室的门前，钟晓飞轻轻的敲门。

钟晓飞推门走进去，“经理。你喊我？”脸上带着笑。虽然心底里对李三石非常的讨厌，但没有办法，见到对方还是得满脸堆笑，谁让对方是自己的顶头上司呢？

钟晓飞在桌前的椅子坐下，规规矩矩的等李三石的吩咐。

李三石是ty公司投资部的总经理，身上笼罩着令人炫目的光芒，不但是国外名牌大学毕业，有显赫的家世，名车，豪宅，七位数以上的存款，还有一个绝世美女当老婆，在ty公司里拥有绝对的权利。可以说，所有男人梦中的一切，他都已经得到了。

唯一令他不满意的，估计就是他的相貌，李三石相貌平平，四十不到的年龄就已经微微的谢顶，身材不高，圆圆胖胖，小鼻子小眼的，和英俊两个字相去甚远。

也不知道当初他是怎么把美女娇妻熊慧林骗到手的？

钟晓飞每次看见李三石，心里总是不免要问这个问题，眼前也会浮现一个画面：李三石猪一样的趴在熊慧林雪白妙曼的娇躯上，握着**，满头大汗的乱拱……然后就是一声不平的感叹：一朵鲜花插在了牛粪上！

但不管内心多么不平和鄙视，表面上钟晓飞对李三石仍然是恭恭敬敬。谁让李三石是他的顶头上司呢？

“小钟，你这月的表现不错。”李三石脸上露出一丝诡异的笑容，起码钟晓飞自我的感觉是很诡异的。

“经理过奖了。”最近这一月钟晓飞的业绩确实很不错，一连做了好几个单子，为公司赚进了不少。钟晓飞估摸着，除了交易税，他应该为公司赚进有七八十万了吧？业绩这么好，李三石夸奖他也正常，不过钟晓飞还是隐隐的有点不安，因为李三石的笑容狡诈干涩，好像隐藏着什么阴谋。

“你脑子好用，下手准，公司里面的这些操盘手，我最欣赏你，”李三石说。

“不过你还需要历练，明天有一次道琼期货交易，你跟着我一起来吧。”李三石的脸上还是带着那种诡异的笑。

钟晓飞不由的吞了一口口水。道琼期货交易可是大买卖，每次动用的自用少说也是几千万以上，而且是美元。钟晓飞到公司这么长的时间，只操作国内的股票，每次能动用的资金虽然也有千万，但那是人民币，忽然的一下让他去操作道琼期货，就好像是一个开三轮的，忽然要去开奔驰，他一时还真有点接受不了！

虽然操作美国的道琼期货，一直是他的梦想。

“李经理，我对道琼期货还不是很熟悉……”钟晓飞向李三石看了一眼，李三石坐在豪华的办公桌后面，一直微笑的在看着他，笑容是有点诡异，但好像也并没有什么恶意。

“嗯，我知道，不过没关系，我相信你有这个能力的，再说了，国内股票和国外的期货差不多，都是赌场，你熟悉了就好了……”李三石安慰的说。一边说，一边从桌上取了一个文件夹递给了钟晓飞，“这个，你拿着回去看一下，有什么问题可以给我打电话……”

钟晓飞接住了，知道这是明天期货交易的资料。

就像是李三石说的那样，国内的股票市场和国外的期货市场，其实都是赌场，只不过一个小，一个大，钟晓飞习惯了在国内的小赌场拼搏，忽然的换一个大场子，钟晓飞心里既兴奋，又紧张。

从李三石的办公室走出来，钟晓飞的脚步有点飘。

参与道琼期货，不止是换一个赌场，而且是换一个身份，李三石虽然没有明说，但钟晓飞知道，他肯定是要升职了。毕竟操作国内股票和操作道琼期货，可不是一个等级的。升职意味着薪金和酬佣的提高，谁能不高兴呢？

“小飞，恭喜啊，”外面的秘书间，何美怡坐在办公桌的后面，冲着钟晓飞眨眼笑。

看来，钟晓飞要升职的消息，她提前知道了。

“呵呵，改天我请何姐吃饭。”钟晓飞笑眯眯的看着香气扑鼻的何美怡。钟晓飞和何美怡的关系一直都很不错，经常的开玩笑，有什么消息何美怡也总会在第一时间通知钟晓飞，所以钟晓飞对她挺感激。

“光请我一个人吗？那我可不敢去。”何美怡笑。

“呵呵，何姐你怕我啊？”钟晓飞坏笑的问。

“是啊，我吃的多，怕你没钱付账。”何美怡咯咯的娇笑，笑的花枝招展，胸前的高耸不住的抖动。

钟晓飞吞了一口口水。熟女的诱惑，有时候比美女还要命。

从秘书间离开，钟晓飞轻松的返回办公室。一个人坐在椅子上,翻看着李三石所给的资料，想着李三石刚才所说的那些话。

升职，是钟晓飞一直所期盼的，不过这一下来的有点突然，钟晓飞的心里隐隐的有些不安，因为他这段时间的业绩虽然好，但也不至于这么快就被李三石看上啊？
content_en:
After yesterday's first smile with the goddess, and even chatting with her at the same table, Zhong Xiaofei felt that the distance between him and the goddess had been narrowed. At least the goddess knew his name, and the two of them knew each other, so today he planned to strike while the iron is hot and wait at the door of the company, pretending to meet the goddess and say hello.It would be best to chat with the goddess for a few words.

Of course, the most important thing is that he has to explain the misunderstanding and tell Wu Yijie that he is not married yet.

Five minutes later, Wu Yijie appeared, wearing a white short-sleeved shirt, a black knee-length skirt, flesh-colored stockings, and white high-heeled shoes. She walked over gracefully with a light step and a standard business attire.

Zhong Xiaofei greeted him excitedly, "Hi, hello..."

Wu Yijie glanced at him coldly, just once, and then turned her head, her beautiful face had a frosty expression, as if she didn't know Zhong Xiaofei at all.

Zhong Xiaofei stood there blankly, the smile on his face gradually stiffened. He gritted his teeth and stammered unwillingly, "Hi, I'm Zhong Xiaofei, have you forgotten? Yesterday..."

Before he finished speaking, Wu Yijie had already raised her head and walked straight past him.

Zhong Xiaofei felt as if he had knocked over a five-flavor bottle, bitter and disappointed...

It seemed that Miss Dai didn't take him seriously at all.

After entering the company and sitting down in his seat, Zhong Xiaofei was in despair. He was not a man who couldn't take it up or let it go. It was just that the situation changed too fast for him to accept.Before going to work, he was full of happy fantasies, but now he was beaten twice.

The phone rang. It was He Meiyi, the female secretary of the investment department.He Meiyi is a beautiful mature woman with big breasts and big butt. She is plump and juicy. Although she is not among the company's top seven beauties, her beauty is not bad at all. And she has just turned thirty this year, which is the age where she is like a wolf and a tiger.It is said that Li Sanshi's wife, Xiong Huilin, was very wary of her and always suspected that her husband had bad intentions in using such a woman as his secretary. However, He Meiyi's job was personally arranged by Chairman Yang Tianzeng, and Li Sanshi could not change it if he wanted.

"Zhong Xiaofei! Come here, Manager Li has something to do with you!" He Meiyi said with a smile in her voice.

"Oh, Sister He, do you know what's going on?" Zhong Xiaofei cheered up and asked in a lowered voice.Li Sanshi is the general manager of the investment department, and Zhong Xiaofei is just a clerk under him. They rarely interact with each other. When he was suddenly called to the office, Zhong Xiaofei couldn't help but feel a little nervous. Could it be that my transaction was wrong?Alas, misfortunes never come singly. I was treated coldly by the goddess just now, and now I am going to be blamed by my boss?

"Good thing!" He Meiyi smiled and hung up the phone.

Zhong Xiaofei felt relieved, put down the phone and walked to Li Sanshi's office.Li Sanshi's office is large and luxurious, almost like a star-rated hotel.In the secretary room outside, He Meiyi was on the phone. The door was open. Zhong Xiaofei stood in front of the door and gently knocked on the door with his finger. He Meiyi looked up and saw him and blinked at him.

He Meiyi is tall, has fat hips, and has big watery eyes. Unlike other beauties in the company, she is a standard mature woman who is married and has a husband. Zhong Xiaofei has also met her husband before, a tall and thin middle-aged man who serves as a senior manager in a foreign company. However, he has just been sent to work abroad. It is estimated that it will take two or three years to come back.

He Meiyi blinked at Zhong Xiaofei and signaled to wait a moment.

Zhong Xiaofei walked in and stood waiting, his eyes naturally falling on He Meiyi.

He Meiyi wore a short-sleeved white shirt issued by the company, with two small buttons on the chest, revealing a large snow-white chest and two jade lotus-like arms, a black skirt, and flesh-colored stockings. When she was on the phone, her thighs kept dangling.Very sexy and refreshing.

"Manager Li, Zhong Xiaofei is here..." It turned out that He Meiyi was on the phone with her boss Li Sanshi.

He Meiyi put down the phone and smiled at Zhong Xiaofei, "The manager asked you to come in."

"Oh." Zhong Xiaofei blinked at He Meiyi and whispered, "Sister He, you are so beautiful today..."

"Stop talking nonsense with me..." He Meiyi was angry,

But Zhong Xiaofei could tell that she actually felt very happy.

Arriving at the door of Li Sanshi's office, Zhong Xiaofei knocked gently.

Zhong Xiaofei pushed the door open and walked in, "Manager. Did you call me?" with a smile on his face.Although I hate Li Sanshi very much in my heart, I have no choice but to smile when I see him. Who makes him his immediate boss?

Zhong Xiaofei sat down on the chair in front of the table and waited for Li Sanshi's instructions.

Li Sanshi is the general manager of the investment department of Ty Company. He is shrouded in a dazzling light. He is not only a graduate of a famous foreign university, but also has a prominent family background, luxury cars, luxury houses, more than seven-digit savings, and a peerless beauty as his wife. He has absolute rights in Ty Company.It can be said that he has achieved everything that any man dreams of.

The only thing that dissatisfied him was probably his appearance. Li Sanshi had an average appearance. He was already slightly bald at the age of less than forty. He was short, chubby, with a small nose and small eyes. He was far from handsome.

I don’t know how he deceived the beautiful wife Xiong Huilin in the first place?

Every time Zhong Xiaofei sees Li Sanshi, he can't help but ask this question in his heart, and a picture will appear in front of his eyes: Li Sanshi is lying on Xiong Huilin's snow-white and graceful body like a pig, holding his penis, sweating profusely... Then there is an unfair exclamation: a flower stuck in cow dung!

But no matter how unfair and contemptuous he was in his heart, on the surface Zhong Xiaofei was still respectful to Li Sanshi.Who made Li Sanshi his immediate boss?

"Xiao Zhong, you have performed well this month." Li Sanshi had a weird smile on his face. At least Zhong Xiaofei felt weird about himself.

"The manager has given me the award." Zhong Xiaofei's performance in the past month has been really good. He has made several orders in a row and made a lot of money for the company.Zhong Xiaofei estimated that apart from transaction tax, he should have earned 700,000 to 800,000 yuan for the company, right?With such good performance, it was normal for Li Sanshi to praise him, but Zhong Xiaofei was still a little uneasy because Li Sanshi's smile was cunning and dry, as if he was hiding some conspiracy.

"You have a good brain and accurate execution. Among the traders in the company, I admire you the most," Li Sanshi said.

"But you still need to practice. There will be a Dow Jones futures trading tomorrow. Come with me." Li Sanshi still had that weird smile on his face.

Zhong Xiaofei couldn't help but swallowed a mouthful of saliva.Dow Jones futures trading is a big business, and the personal use each time is at least tens of millions, and it is US dollars.Zhong Xiaofei has been in the company for such a long time and only operates domestic stocks. Although the funds he can use each time are tens of millions, they are in RMB. Suddenly he is asked to operate Dow Jones futures, just like a three-wheeler who suddenly wants to drive a Mercedes-Benz. He really can't accept it for a moment!

Although operating the US Dow Jones futures has always been his dream.

"Manager Li, I'm not very familiar with Dow Jones futures..." Zhong Xiaofei glanced at Li Sanshi. Li Sanshi was sitting behind a luxurious desk and looking at him with a smile. The smile was a little weird, but there didn't seem to be any malice.

"Well, I know, but it doesn't matter. I believe you have the ability. Besides, domestic stocks are similar to foreign futures. They are both casinos. It will be fine if you get familiar with them..." Li Sanshi said comfortingly.As he spoke, he took a folder from the table and handed it to Zhong Xiaofei, "Here, take it back and look at it. If you have any questions, you can call me..."

Zhong Xiaofei caught it and knew that it was the information for tomorrow's futures trading.

As Li Sanshi said, the domestic stock market and the foreign futures market are actually casinos, but one is small and the other is large. Zhong Xiaofei is used to working hard in small domestic casinos, but suddenly a big one changes. Zhong Xiaofei is excited and nervous at the same time.

Walking out of Li Sanshi's office, Zhong Xiaofei's steps were a little wandering.

Participating in Dow Jones futures is not only a change of casino, but also a change of identity. Although Li Sanshi did not say it explicitly, Zhong Xiaofei knew that he was definitely going to be promoted.After all, operating domestic stocks and operating Dow Jones futures are not on the same level.Promotion means an increase in salary and remuneration. Who can not be happy?

"Xiao Fei, congratulations," He Meiyi was sitting behind the desk in the secretarial room outside, winking and smiling at Zhong Xiaofei.

It seemed that she knew about Zhong Xiaofei's promotion in advance.

"Haha, I'll treat Sister He to dinner another day." Zhong Xiaofei looked at the fragrant He Meiyi with a smile.Zhong Xiaofei and He Meiyi have always had a good relationship. They often joke around, and He Meiyi will always notify Zhong Xiaofei as soon as there is any news, so Zhong Xiaofei is very grateful to her.

"Are you just going to invite me alone? Then I don't dare to go." He Meiyi smiled.

"Haha, Sister He, are you afraid of me?" Zhong Xiaofei asked with a wicked smile.

"Yes, I eat too much, and I'm afraid you won't have money to pay the bill." He Meiyi giggled, her smile spread out, and her breasts trembled uncontrollably.

Zhong Xiaofei swallowed a mouthful of saliva.The temptation of mature women is sometimes more powerful than that of beautiful women.

Leaving the secretary room, Zhong Xiaofei returned to the office easily.A man was sitting on a chair, looking through the information given by Li Sanshi, and thinking about what Li Sanshi had just said.

Promotion is what Zhong Xiaofei has always been looking forward to, but this one is a bit sudden. Zhong Xiaofei feels a little uneasy because although his performance during this period is good, he will not be favored by Li Sanshi so quickly?
